key_insight: A tumour-aware AI framework combining MRI, radiomic features, and clinical information outperformed an MRI-only baseline for predicting glioma IDH mutation status.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support non-invasive molecular assessment of gliomas, but clinical use requires further validation.
method: Integrates T1, T1CE, T2, and FLAIR MRI sequences.
Combines tumour subregion segmentation, radiomic descriptors, and clinical information.
Uses Grad-CAM to visualise regions influencing predictions.
evidence_signal: Ablation studies and multiple classification metrics favoured the Clinical Fusion model, but the abstract reports no sample size or numerical performance estimates.
watch_item: External validation is not described in the abstract, leaving generalisability across centres and MRI protocols uncertain.
paper_title: A Tumour-Aware Multimodal Framework for Explainable Prediction of IDH Mutation in Gliomas from Multi-Sequence MRI
